A '''goal-judge''' was a referee used in the sport known as the [[trophy chase]] on [[Dalos IV]]. The goal-judges enforced the few rules in the sport, and were stationed on the stable [[neph]]s that had [[target-ring]]s hanging underneath them.<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
